schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship (OBC)
schemes.description: Tuition + maintenance allowance for OBC students in higher education.
schemes.long_description: Central/state post-matric scholarship for OBC students pursuing studies after class 10. Covers tuition fees and maintenance allowance based on course type.

eligibility_rules.reason: Needs OBC category and household income ≤ ₹3,50,000/year.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship (SC)
schemes.description: Full fee reimbursement and maintenance for SC students.
schemes.long_description: Scholarship scheme for Scheduled Caste students studying in post-matric courses with fee waiver and monthly stipend.

eligibility_rules.reason: Needs SC category and household income ≤ ₹2,50,000/year.

schemes.name: PAN — address update
schemes.description: Update the address on your PAN record.
schemes.long_description: Request NSDL/UTIITSL to update residential or office address linked to your PAN.

eligibility_rules.reason: Fetch or upload your PAN card first.

schemes.name: Income certificate
schemes.description: Self-attested certificate needed for scholarships, fee waivers, and PM-JAY.
schemes.long_description: Apply for an official income certificate from your tehsildar / e-District portal. Valid typically for 1 year.
benefits: Valid proof of income for schemes

schemes.name: Voter ID — address update
schemes.description: Update your electoral roll entry after moving house.
schemes.long_description: File Form 8 on the ECI portal / app to correct or update address, name, photo, or other particulars on the electoral roll.

schemes.name: New Voter ID registration
schemes.description: First-time electoral roll registration (Form 6) for citizens 18+.
schemes.long_description: Register as a new voter if you turned 18 or never enrolled. Get your EPIC card.

schemes.name: Caste / validity certificate
schemes.description: Apply for caste certificate or validity certificate for reservations.
schemes.long_description: Obtain SC/ST/OBC caste certificate from competent authority; validity certificate required for professional college admissions in Maharashtra.

schemes.name: Domicile certificate
schemes.description: Proof of residence in the state for education & jobs.
schemes.long_description: Domicile / residence certificate issued by tehsildar proving you are a resident of the state for a required period.

schemes.name: Birth certificate (delayed registration)
schemes.description: Register a birth or get a copy of an existing birth certificate.
schemes.long_description: Apply for birth registration / certified copy via municipal corporation or CRS portal.

schemes.name: Fresh passport application
schemes.description: Apply for a new Indian passport (36/60 pages).
schemes.long_description: First-time passport application via Passport Seva. Requires online form, fee payment, and PSK appointment.

schemes.name: New driving licence
schemes.description: Apply for a learner's and permanent driving licence.
schemes.long_description: Get LL then DL via Parivahan Sewa. Requires age proof, address proof, and medical certificate for certain classes.

schemes.name: GST registration
schemes.description: Register your business under GST and get GSTIN.
schemes.long_description: Mandatory for businesses crossing turnover threshold or doing inter-state supply. Obtain 15-digit GSTIN.

eligibility_rules.reason: PAN is mandatory for GST registration.

schemes.name: PAN–Aadhaar linking status / link
schemes.description: Ensure your PAN is linked with Aadhaar to avoid higher TDS.
schemes.long_description: Linking PAN with Aadhaar is mandatory. Unlinked PANs face higher TDS and become inoperative.

eligibility_rules.reason: Both PAN and Aadhaar must be in your vault.
